==English==
{{wp|<dab!>}}
[[File:Google 2026 logo.svg|thumb|Logo of Google]]

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=Q95|:from|google<id:100>|tree=1}}
An accidental misspelling of {{m|en|googol||one followed by a hundred zeros}}, alluding to the site's purpose of providing easy access to vast amounts of information.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɡuː.ɡəl/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-googol.ogg|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|en-uk-Google.ogg|a=UK}}
* {{rhymes|en|uːɡəl|s=2}}
* {{hmp|en|google|googol}}

===Proper noun===
{{en-prop}}

# {{senseid|en|Q95}} {{lb|en|trademark}} A particular [[Internet]] [[company]].
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Rishi Iyengar|title=Google will stop making video games for its Stadia platform|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/02/01/tech/google-stadia-sge-shutdown|date=2021-02-01|passage='''Google''' is one of several Big Tech firms that has made an aggressive push into gaming in recent years, along with Amazon (AMZN), Apple (AAPL) and Facebook (FB).|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220820173228/https://www.cnn.com/2021/02/01/tech/google-stadia-sge-shutdown/}}
# {{senseid|en|Q9366}} {{lb|en|computing|trademark}} {{w|Google Search}}, a very popular [[search engine]] operated by the company of the same name.
#: {{ux|en|He did some research on '''Google''' for his history project.}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb|+|+,~ing,~-ing}}

# {{alternative case form of|en|google}}.
#* {{RQ:Gibson Pattern Recognition|page=2|passage='''Google''' Damien and you will find a director of music videos and commercials. '''Google''' Cayce and you will find “coolhunter,” and if you look closely you may see it suggested that she is a “sensitive” of some kind, a dowser in the world of global marketing.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|author=w:David Gratzer|chapter=Statement of David Gratzer, M.D., Senior Fellow, Manhattan Institute for Policy Research|title=Getting Better Value in Health Care: Hearing Before the Committee on the Budget House of Representatives;{{nb...|One Hundred Tenth Congress; Second Session; Hearing Held in Washington, DC, July 16, 2008}}|series=Serial No. 110–37|location=Washington, D.C.|publisher=[[w:United States Government Publishing Office|U.S. Government Printing Office]]|date=16 July 2008|page=23|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/gov.gpo.fdsys.CHRG-110hhrg44037/page/n26/mode/1up?view=theater|passage=We are not super-tech-savvy people because we would have '''Googled''', I suspect, but we Yahooed, and the top 10 sites were pornographic.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|author=Michael Schneider|chapter=Companies and Airlines: Negotiation Positions – Negotiation Options|editors=Roland Conrady; Martin Buck|title=Trends and Issues in Global Tourism 2010|publisher=w:[[Springer Science+Business Media|Springer]]|year=2010|page=211|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/trendsissuesingl0000itbc/page/211/mode/1up|isbn=978-3-642-10828-0|passage='''Googleing''' the name of your counterpart will most likely tell you even more: Facebook and the like will tell about hobbies, family etc. and hence give you valuable information on the motivational set of the person.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|author=Melinda Wells [pen name]: Linda Palmer|title=Pie à la Murder|location=New York, N.Y.|publisher=[[w:Berkley Books|Berkley Prime Crime]]|year=2011|page=113|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/isbn_9780425242216/page/113/mode/1up?view=theater|isbn=978-0-425-24221-6|passage=He must have '''Googled''' or Binged me and found out about one of Phil Logan’s early publicity stunts where he had me suited up like a Los Angeles Dodger so his photographer could take a picture of me holding a baseball bat.}}
